ads.headline: Rohtak mein industrial plot
ads.text: Factory ke liye land? Forteasia Industrial Township, Kalanaur, Rohtak. 400 se 4,000 sq yd ke plots, 18 m aur 24 m wide roads, NH-152D se 10 min. HRERA-PKL-ROH-653-2025, www.haryanarera.gov.in. Neeche button par click karke aur jaaniye.
ads.prefill: Hi, FIT industrial plot ki details bhejiye.
